confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors are reasonably consistent across several crowd-sourced aggregator figures and menus, dated 2025 to 2026 rather than July 2026 specifically. The mid-range two-person meal is least certain because sources differ about two-fold. Cocktail and wine rest on a small, mixed-age set of venue listings, mostly beach clubs, not a beer-based estimate; beer was used only as a plausibility check. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no accommodation searches, booking pages or current listings were used, so treat them as lower confidence. The FX value comes from a search-result summary citing the RBA page, which was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used for food and drink. Those anchors rest on Mombasa-specific cost-of-living aggregator figures and Mombasa-area venue listings seen in web search results (no full page reads). Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for the coastal Kenya hotel market around Mombasa (island, Nyali, Bamburi).
